title: HoldingsSnapshot
description: Current portfolio holdings. Unlike the IPS, this is current-state data — overwritten as holdings change, not versioned/append-only.

as_of.description: When this snapshot was last refreshed.

asset_class.description: Must match one of the IPS's target_allocation asset classes for drift comparison to be meaningful.

total_value_usd.description: Sum of all positions' market_value_usd plus cash_usd. Denominator for drift and concentration checks.
